mapper.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(PPS.PAY_SCHEDULE_NO) AS CODE, TO_CHAR(PPS.PAY_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') || ' ' || GET_GLOBAL_NAME(PPS.SALARY_DISTIN_NO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS NAME, PWF.PA_CONFIRM_FLAG FROM PA_PAY_SCHEDULE PPS, PA_WORK_FLOW PWF WHERE PPS.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND PPS.PAY_SCHEDULE_NO = PWF.PAY_SCHEDULE_NO AND PPS.ACTIVITY = 1 ORDER BY PPS.PAY_DATE DESC

SELECT A.ITEM_NO AS CODE, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(A.ITEM_NO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS NAME, NULL AS PA_CONFIRM_FLAG FROM AR_STA_ITEM A, AR_STA_ITEM_PARAM B WHERE A.ITEM_NO = B.ITEM_NO AND B.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND B.MANAGE_FLAG = 1 ORDER BY B.CAL_ORDER

sql.if: AND ( HRE.EMPID LIKE '%' || #{key, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' OR CONVERTTOUNSIGN(UPPER(HRE.LOCAL_NAME)) LIKE '%' || CONVERTTOUNSIGN(UPPER(#{key, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) || '%' OR UPPER(HRE.ENGLISH_NAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{key, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) || '%' )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM HR_DEPARTMENT D WHERE D.DEPTNO = HRE.DEPTNO AND D.ACTIVITY = 1 START WITH D.DEPTNO = #{deptNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR} CONNECT BY PRIOR D.DEPTNO = D.PARENT_DEPT_NO )

SELECT HRE.PERSON_ID, HRE.EMPID, HRE.LOCAL_NAME, HRE.DEPTNO, GET_DEPT_NAME(HRE.DEPTNO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS DEPTNAME, ASM.ITEM_NO, NVL(ASM.FINAL_VALUE, ASM.CAL_VALUE) AS EXPORT_VALUE FROM AR_SUMMARY_MANAGE_HTSV ASM, HR_EMPLOYEE HRE, PA_PAY_SCHEDULE PPS WHERE ASM.PERSON_ID = HRE.PERSON_ID AND ASM.PAY_SCHEDULE_NO = PPS.PAY_SCHEDULE_NO AND PPS.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ASM.PAY_SCHEDULE_NO = #{payScheduleNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
ORDER BY HRE.DEPTNO, HRE.EMPID
